name: print-social-spiral-calendar-sticker-bakery-post
title: Bakery promo stuck on a spiral wall calendar
whatItIs: A 4:5 post showing a close-up of a spiral-bound wall calendar page with heavy black rules. A cut-out cake and slice sit on one day cell with a blue blob logo 'cake palette', a coral starburst SALE sticker and a cream oval 'the cake shop' label.
whatItMeans: Cute, dated and easy to grasp: the calendar says 'mark this day', and the stickers make the promo feel hand-placed and playful.
techniques: Use a familiar object (calendar page) as the layout so a date-based message reads instantly.
Drop cut-out product photos and sticker labels onto one cell to make the focal point.
Keep the base neutral grey-white so a small cluster of blue, coral and cream pops.
Use a starburst badge for sale info, echoing retail signage.
Set the month and year in chunky rounded type to match the sticker voice.

vocabulary.definition: A spiky circular shape used to flag offers.
Using a real-world item (calendar, receipt, folder) as the frame of a design.
A tight group of overlapping stickers forming the focal point.
A rounded organic shape behind text.
